name: deskcrit
description: A command-line design critic that asks TypeSafe's Jev model typed questions about a picture of a design.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p evals/agreement && tsc --noEmit -p evals/wobble && tsc --noEmit -p evals/adversarial && tsc --noEmit -p evals/packs-test && tsc --noEmit -p evals/critic
scripts.test:live: npm run test:live:packs; packs_code=$?; node evals/agreement/run-agreement.ts --live; agreement_code=$?; node evals/agreement/run-compare.ts --live; compare_code=$?; worst=$packs_code; if [ $agreement_code -gt $worst ]; then worst=$agreement_code; fi; if [ $compare_code -gt $worst ]; then worst=$compare_code; fi; exit $worst
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
